{{Top}}
A '''baffler''', also called a '''sensor baffle''', was a device that was used to hide [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] emissions.

==Characteristics==
Sensor baffles came in a variety of sizes and types, and were used on everything from [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Relin Druur]] and [[Drev Hassin]]'s [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was equipped with a baffler and a [[Scrambler/Legends|scrambler]] to help hide the fighter's signature.

The [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] had sensor bafflers that were disguised as soldering welds. The bafflers prevented the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] surveillance unit from being detected by routine scans.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
